_note: NSS's six cups per hole (bones GolfCourseNNholeK of the course model Fld_GolfCourseNN, k = 0..5: the cup bottoms), from the eden dump through tools/nss-registration.json. x, y = map fractions; world = the bone, NSS metres; surfaceY = the green surface over the cup (the top of HoleCover k, the plug that closes cup k while another is in play; 0.251-0.339 m above the bone; the game sets the flag pin at bone + 0.30), surfaceYd = it in yd above the datum (NSS y 0 = the WSR start's height); mesh = WSR KCL units at the surface; difficult = GolfFieldMgrParam HoleParams[hole-1].CupDifficulties[k] (the game leaves those out of some draws); ydFromWsrStart / ydFromTeeObj = the flat distance from the WSR start / the GlfTeeOBJ bone; nearestWsr = the nearest WSR pin spot (tools/wsr-pins.json, id s<slot>) and wsr = its id when it is within 0.3 yd (the same spot). cover.hub = the centre vertex of the cover's 20-triangle fan, dxzMm its offset from the bone (the collision's vertices sit on a 1/512 m grid). tees: Glf_RotateOBJ (where the online platform stands), GlfTeeOBJ (the local tee bone) and the WSR start (the app's tee for now). Generated by tools/nss-export.mjs. Switch Sports Resort dump (holes are SR's 1-27; difficult = AnnaGolfFieldParam OfficialScene HoleParams[n - 1].CupDifficulties[k]): SR 23 (cup bones GolfCourse20holeK), 24 and 25 are NSS 20, 19 and 21, taking the WSR start and spots of WSR holes 20, 19 and 21 (SR 23's tee is far behind WSR 20's start, so its ydFromWsrStart is the old hole's distance: the app reads ydFromTeeObj); the new holes (SR 19, 20, 21, 22, 26, 27) have no WSR data: tees.wsrStart null, wsr and nearestWsr null, ydFromWsrStart = ydFromTeeObj. SR 27's cup 0 cover is a two-ring disc (60 triangles), its hub the vertex of the inner 20-triangle fan. x / y are in SR's own map frame on SR 17, 23 and the new holes (nss-registration.json).
